parts.text: Solve the current shared-chat extraction problem from the supplied evidence. The public ChatGPT share page has already been downloaded successfully into untrusted AI/shared-chat-page.html. Determine exactly how the conversation is embedded/serialized in that HTML and return an executable Node.js extractor that reconstructs the complete conversation into untrusted AI/shared-chat.json. Use the actual diagnostics rather than generic assumptions. The solution must include deterministic validation that proves a real conversation object/message mapping was extracted. Do not propose ExportMyChat, browser extensions, account export, or another fetch unless the evidence makes that unavoidable. Retry this same transaction with the increased evaluator request timeout; the prior attempt produced no evaluation result because the HTTP call timed out.
